description: NAMOA* is A* for several objectives: it finds one path for every Pareto-optimal cost vector. A cost vector is *Pareto-optimal* when no other path is as cheap in every objective and cheaper in one. Each state keeps the cost vectors of its open labels and of its expanded labels. A new label survives only if no open label, expanded label or solution weakly dominates it, and it removes the open labels it dominates. With a heuristic that never overestimates in any objective (*admissible*), the result is the full Pareto set; with the zero heuristic, NAMOA* is the multi-objective label-setting algorithm of Martins.
